Blend into the pixels and don't get spotted! 🎨 Every round you get a giant pixel-art painting. Paint your character block by block to match the picture, then freeze and hope nobody finds you. 🕵️

⚔️ Go head to head against another player. Whoever blends in best wins the round. First to win 2 rounds wins the whole game! 🏆

🔥 Build up your win streak
💥 Troll your opponent with jumpscares, flash bangs, screen shakes and more
🖼️ Tons of pixel paintings to hide in

👍 LIKE + JOIN GROUP 👍

Our Game Supports
💻 PC | 🎮 Console | 📱 Mobile

Invite your friends for even more fun! 🤗
Play with friends for FREE on our free private servers! 🎮

This game is inspired by Mecca Chameleon.
